Alyssa (CS): Heads-up — Orchard beta cohort enrollment is bumping up against our enablement capacity (22 signed). Need to reshuffle a few slots so we don't auto-waitlist folks. Sign-up sheet: https://tiny.redwood/orchard-enroll
Mike (AE): cc @Alyssa — which accounts are highest risk if we delay their onboarding?
Alyssa (CS): Priority: Zenith (renewal convo in 6w), Solace (heavy integration), FinEdge (data connectors). I annotated the sheet with risk tags.
Jordan (CS): I can move two Tue afternoon sessions to Fri morning, that clears 3 spots. @Sam can you confirm FinEdge availability?
Sam (Engineer): Reached out to FinEdge contact (LauraT). No reply yet, I left times: Fri 11am, Mon 10am. If no confirm by EOD we offer recorded walkthrough + an office hour 1:1.
Laura (PM): For feedback capture can we use the new micro-survey (3 quick Qs + 1-5 satisfaction)? template: https://tiny.redwood/survey-v2 — can we append cohort_id tag?
Alyssa (CS): Yes — survey should be mandatory post-session. Add cohort_id and "enablement_type" (live/recorded) so product can slice. If score <= 2 trigger an immediate 1:1.
Orchard-bot: Reminder — cohort size >20 will auto-create waitlist. Current cohort=22.
Emma (SE): I can join the office hour for FinEdge to unblock integration questions — Fri 11am works for me.
Mike (AE): Fri 11am PT works for most accounts. @Jordan can you slot Emma + FinEdge then?
Jordan (CS): Done — moved sessions, updated calendar invites, added "high-touch" tag in CRM for FinEdge and Zenith. Marking renewal_risk=high for Zenith.
Alyssa (CS): Updated the playbook snippet: onboarding -> live session -> micro-survey -> 1:1 if score <=2. New doc: /docs/playbooks/beta-onboard.md (please review).
Mike (AE): I'll escalate Zenith's renewal to the customer exec to get time on their calendar.
Alyssa (CS): Action checklist: [Jordan] shift slots (complete), [Sam] confirm FinEdge (pending), [Emma] attend Fri 11 office hour, [Mike] escalate Zenith. Re-check status tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
Jordan (CS): copying notes to the thread so CS ops can track: FinEdge follow-up EOD, Zenith flagged for renewal ops, survey template linked.
Alyssa (CS): Thanks team — want to keep this tight so we don't lose momentum. I'll post a short recap once FinEdge confirms.
